budget.runs: 5 solos + 1 joint, identical budget, identical frozen train-tail probe (seeded)

reported_per_epoch_per_family: pairwise cosine on the frozen probe: sign frequency, median, lower quartile (p25), max consecutive-negative persistence
weighted gradient norm per objective (effective_weight x probe grad norm)
per-objective PROBE loss in solo vs joint training
representation variance and contrastive effective negatives

disposition_rule_fixed_before_the_run.TRANSIENT_DISAGREEMENT: pair negative-sign frequency < 0.5 OR median cosine >= -0.3
disposition_rule_fixed_before_the_run.PERSISTENT_TENSION_NO_HARM: sign frequency >= 0.6 AND median < -0.3, AND neither objective of the pair degrades (joint final probe loss <= 1.2 x its solo final probe loss)
disposition_rule_fixed_before_the_run.MATERIAL_CONFLICT_DEGRADATION: an objective's joint final probe loss > 1.2 x its solo final probe loss AND (its weighted-gradient share < 1/5 of the pair partner in >= half the epochs OR a pair median < -0.5 with sign frequency >= 0.75)
disposition_rule_fixed_before_the_run.DOMINANCE: one objective's weighted gradient norm > 5x EVERY other objective in >= 6 of 8 epochs
disposition_rule_fixed_before_the_run.note: monitor results are NEVER consulted; no threshold retuning after the run; the disposition names outcomes, it does not auto-remove objectives — removal stays with Musashi
